design.skeletonName: Interrupted diagonal returns and valley joins

plate.title: B32 · Banded diagonal courses and quiet diamond inlays
plate.description: The original interrupted diagonal courses lead every scale. Their separate central ends, diagonal half-drop and authenticated valley contacts remain intact. One small fourfold diamond inlay, articulated by nesting at finer readings, attaches to an actual course port. Broad and banded ink is an optional presentation of the retained courses, not a new ribbon face or topological join.

constructionNotes: The original interrupted diagonal courses lead every scale. Their separate central ends, diagonal half-drop and authenticated valley contacts remain intact.
